title: ONS 2026 atmospheric-emissions dataset revision QA controls

sources.title: Atmospheric emissions: greenhouse gases by industry and gas

facts.source_fact: The atmospheric greenhouse-gas dataset covers the UK from 1990 to 2024.
facts.expected_handling: Carry the time-series coverage with extracts and comparisons.

facts.source_fact: The dataset covers CO2, CH4, N2O, HFCs, PFCs, SF6, NF3 and total greenhouse-gas emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve gas identity and do not infer an omitted gas from totals.

facts.source_fact: Industry detail is based on SIC 2007 groups covering around 130 categories.
facts.expected_handling: Attach the industry classification basis to sector-level rows.

facts.source_fact: The dataset release date is 5 June 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Store release date separately from reference year.

facts.source_fact: ONS provides previous dataset versions so users can access data as it existed on earlier dates.
facts.expected_handling: Retain version provenance when comparing revised extracts.

facts.source_fact: ONS states that initial estimates may be revised as further data become available.
facts.expected_handling: Mark initial estimates as revision-prone.

facts.source_fact: ONS also revises statistics when methods or systems change.
facts.expected_handling: Differentiate methodological revision from new-data revision.

facts.source_fact: ONS distinguishes planned revisions from genuine errors in released statistics.
facts.expected_handling: Do not label a planned revision as a correction error.

facts.source_fact: ONS says genuine mistakes are corrected in a timely manner and announced and explained to users.
facts.expected_handling: Require correction provenance when a value changes because of an error.

facts.source_fact: ONS corrected an error in provisional gas table 2b on 2 March 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Reject superseded table-2b values after the correction date.

facts.source_fact: The March 2026 correction concerned incorrect 2023 carbon-dioxide values for some industries.
facts.expected_handling: Scope the correction to the affected gas, year and industries.

facts.source_fact: ONS identifies affected SIC groups including B7 to C11.07, C19.1, C19.2 and H49.4.
facts.expected_handling: Do not extrapolate the correction to unaffected industry codes.

facts.source_fact: ONS notes that the current dataset provides all economic sectors while provisional data provide top-level estimates.
facts.expected_handling: Do not compare detail levels as though they have identical granularity.

facts.source_fact: Environmental Accounts residence estimates include UK residents and UK-registered businesses wherever they are in the world.
facts.expected_handling: Tag residence-basis records before comparison with territorial data.

facts.source_fact: Residence-basis estimates exclude foreign visitors and foreign businesses in the UK.
facts.expected_handling: Do not assume all activity physically inside the UK belongs in residence totals.

facts.source_fact: The residence basis is aligned with GDP and GVA accounting, enabling direct comparison with economic measures.
facts.expected_handling: Keep the national-accounts alignment metadata with derived intensity metrics.

facts.source_fact: ONS estimates 2024 UK residence-basis greenhouse-gas emissions at 478 MtCO2e.
facts.expected_handling: Treat the value as a national residence estimate, not a parcel measurement.

facts.source_fact: ONS reports residence-basis emissions in 2024 were 41.8% lower than in 1990.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve the stated baseline and accounting basis for trend claims.

facts.source_fact: Households accounted for 25.9% of residence-basis emissions in 2024.
facts.expected_handling: Do not merge household share into an individual industry share.

facts.source_fact: Industries as a whole accounted for 74.1% of residence-basis emissions in 2024.
facts.expected_handling: Treat the aggregate industry share separately from individual industries.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited source fact without broadening its scope.
Attach residence basis, gas, industry and detail level before downstream use.
Carry reference year, release date, version and correction status.
Carry ONS source URL, dataset version and revision rationale.
Do not convert national or industry atmospheric accounts into parcel-level measured emissions.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
